definition: Large movable equipment used to make a room suitable for living.

definition: A sweet crystalline substance obtained from various plants.

definition: A container with a narrow neck used for storing liquids.

definition: As much or as many as required.

definition: A small cardboard box or container.

definition: A kilogram, metric unit of weight.

definition: A thin, broad piece of food cut from a larger portion.

definition: A paper or cardboard container in which goods are packed.
